description: METHOD.md §7.4 and §8: the one-time method 2.2 re-base (PLAN-OF-PLANS §7.0b, decision L15). Step 1: non-goal rows and checks leave the score for every framework. Step 2: the .NET scope adds Orleans and the Durable Task Framework as first-party Microsoft; every fault, dist, conc and msg row is re-checked cell by cell. Generated once by .tmp/plan11/m22/apply.py; the scorecard's v2 levels and met lists are the source of truth. In cells, before is the method 2.1 cell, after the method 2.2 cell (both steps), and rechecked lists every check the snapshot did not credit first-party, with the evidence for the 2.2 answer.
rule: A met check that relies on a third-party library counts at the framework's level only if the framework's own official docs recommend that library ('recommended'); otherwise ('other') the row scores the higher of: without that check at its level, or with it at the labs level (cap 39). 'not_met' checks are removed. Method 2.2: a non-goal (row or check) is set only by a locked decision and never on a check id_effect meets; Orleans and the Durable Task Framework count as first-party for .NET.
sources_cited_not_fetched: Pages cited for context only (overview, observers, sub-orchestrations, streaming, TLS configuration) were not fetched on 2026-10-18; no check is credited on them.

not_non_goals.why: id_effect meets it (`id-effect dev` rebuild-and-restart); a met check is never a non-goal (0.11.0.md D3).

rechecked.evidence: Orleans broadcast channels deliver to implicitly subscribed grains through Orleans Streams in a silo, are not persistent and are not an in-process hub with per-subscriber queues (https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/orleans/streaming/broadcast-channel). Conservatively not met.
Orleans and Durable Task add no channel/queue primitives; System.Threading.Channels already scored. Not met.

Orleans grains are virtual actors with no parent/child lifetime (https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/orleans/overview); Durable Task sub-orchestrations are not scoped to the parent by default (https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-functions/durable/durable-functions-sub-orchestrations). Not met.

Orleans runs each activation turn-based on a cooperative scheduler and warns against long turns; no preemption or auto-yield (https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/orleans/grains/request-scheduling). Not met.

Neither the Orleans test cluster nor the Durable Task in-process test host documents a virtual-time scheduler (https://github.com/microsoft/durabletask-dotnet/tree/main/src/InProcessTestHost). Not met.

Durable Task worker caps (DurableTaskWorkerOptions MaximumConcurrentActivityWorkItems) bound a worker, not parallel work in process code; no memory-aware admission (https://github.com/microsoft/durabletask-dotnet/blob/main/src/Worker/Core/DurableTaskWorkerOptions.cs). Not met.
Durable fan-out/fan-in has no ambient concurrency budget inherited by combinators (https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-functions/durable/durable-functions-overview). Not met.
Neither documents a per-task/connection memory footprint. Not met.

Orleans clustering providers (Azure Table, ADO.NET, Redis, Cosmos DB, Cassandra, Kubernetes hosting) use a membership table or the Kubernetes API, not DNS records (https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/orleans/implementation/cluster-management). Not met.

Broadcast channels and streams use implicit or explicit stream subscriptions; there is no process-group join/leave/members API (https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/orleans/streaming/broadcast-channel). Not met.

Grains do not exit, so there are no cross-node monitors; IClusterMembershipService reports silo status, not process exit (https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/orleans/implementation/cluster-management). Not met.
No cross-node links between grains. Not met.

Orleans secures silo links with TLS/mTLS (Microsoft.Orleans.Connections.Security, already credited for #4); no separate challenge-response node secret (https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/orleans/host/configuration-guide/transport-layer-security). Not met.
No links or exit propagation between grains (https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/orleans/grains). Not met.
Grain observers are application callbacks, not DOWN monitors (https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/orleans/grains/observers). Not met.
Reentrant/AlwaysInterleave/MayInterleave control interleaving of requests, not selective receive, deferral or priority (https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/orleans/grains/request-scheduling). Not met.

No FSM library in Orleans or Durable Task; a grain or durable entity can host a hand-written state machine, which is DIY, not a met check. #3, #4, #5, #8 not met; #1, #2, #6, #7 stay Stateless (other, labs).
